author: Brad Arnett (CodePen: bradarnett)
implementation: Original drawing and Three.js scene code with small documented test adaptations; compiled CSS captured from original preview.
features: Animated 3D pencil follows cursor with tilt and lift
Five colors, shown at viewport widths >=1024px

integration: Serve index.html with the sibling runtime files; Three.js r83 is loaded from cdnjs. Keep classic script order (not modules): Three.js, MTLLoader.js, OBJLoader.js, sketch.js.

Model loading status shown during initialization.
Explicit page width/height keeps controls positioned in canvas-only mode.
